events.title: 13th Annual Trick or Trunk
events.description: 13th Annual Trick or Trunk Put on your favorite costume and join the Dickinson Area Chamber of Commerce for the 13th Annual Trick or Trunk on Saturday, October 31, from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM in Downtown Legacy Square and the two blocks surrounding City Hall. This free, family-friendly Halloween tradition brings together local businesses, organizations, and the community for an afternoon of trick-or-treating, festive fun, and plenty of candy! Children and families are invited to stroll through downtown, visit participating businesses and decorated trunks, and enjoy a safe and exciting Halloween experience. Event Highlights Trick-or-treating with local businesses and organizations Decorated trunks and festive displays Safe, family-friendly Halloween fun Thousands of pieces of candy for little ghosts and goblins Costumes encouraged for all ages! Best Decorated Trunk/Space Contest Returns! Participating businesses and organizations will once again compete for the title of Best Decorated Trunk/Space. Event attendees will have the opportunity to vote for their favorite display by scanning QR codes located throughout the event. Voting will close at the end of Trick or Trunk, and the winner will be announced on the Dickinson Area Chamber of Commerce's social media following the event. Whether you're a business looking to connect with the community or a family looking to celebrate Halloween, Trick or Trunk is an event you won't want to miss. Event Details Date: Saturday, October 31 Time: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM Location: Downtown Legacy Square and the two blocks surrounding City Hall \(same route as last year\) Admission is free, so gather your family, wear your best costume, and join us for one of Dickinson's favorite Halloween traditions. We can't wait to celebrate with you!

events.title: West Marches D&D
events.description: In an effort to include more people, we are excited to introduce our new, more casual Dungeons & Dragons campaign - West Marches D&D! YOU MAY WANT TO JOIN WEST MARCHES D&D IF… 1. You cannot consistently show up to game at our usual rotation of every other week. 2. You are not sure if you like it and don’t want to commit to anything too hard. 3. You are okay with a rotating cast of players and characters that can change each game. 4. You like to keep it simple – explore, kill monsters, get treasure, and level up! 5. You like a hex-crawler, sandbox game driven by the player characters. One thing to keep in mind: Even if you are added to the campaign, due to the West Marches style of play you may not be able to play in every session. Registration will open exactly one week prior to each session and is first come, first served, limited to only 6 spots per session to facilitate more engaging play. Discord will be an important aspect of engaging with this campaign and a server invitation will be provided by the DM. If you would like to participate in West Marches D&D at the library, please reach out to our resident Dungeon Master at rachel.waldo@dickinsongov.com or 701-456-7027 for more information. West Marches D&D is geared toward adventurers ages 13\+. \*Sign-up Required! One registration per participant. Improper registrations may be cancelled at the library's discretion. Please contact the library or cancel your registration if you cannot attend to open the spot up to someone else. If you are wait-listed, you may show up and see if a spot opened up, though there is no guarantee a spot will be open. \*If you are more than 5 minutes late for a program, we will assume you are not coming and will allow waiting patrons to attend

events.title: Double Dinks: Dink, Laugh, Repeat
events.description:
Get ready for Double Dinks: Dink, Laugh, Repeat, a fun, social, and inclusive pickleball mini tournament designed for players of all skill levels! This doubles event features fixed partners, with teams consisting of any combination of pairings. Teams will be placed into divisions based on their combined player rating, ensuring balanced and competitive matchups. The tournament will follow a pool play \(round robin\) format, where each team faces every other team in their division once.

Players are encouraged to bring energy and creativity to the court. Prizes will be awarded for Top Team, Bottom Team, and Best Dressed Team.

AGES: 8\+

FEE: $10

DEADLINE: March 4

REGISTER ONLINE

events.title: CTRL Play: Grades 6-8
events.description:
Ready for an epic night of gaming, snacks, and hanging out with your friends? Join us for CTRL Play in the Golf Simulator/Gaming Room at the WRCC! Whether you’re looking to challenge your friends, discover a new game, or just relax and have fun, this is the place to be.

We’ll have Xbox and Nintendo Switch consoles available, along with plenty of opportunities to connect with friends and fellow gamers. Enjoy free snacks and drinks throughout the event to keep you fueled for the action.

Come play, compete, and socialize at CTRL Play. We can’t wait to see you there!

This FREE event is for GRADES 6-8.

events.title: "It's a Big Dill" Pickleball Tournament
events.description:
Join us for the 4th Annual Dakota Community Bank & Trust “It’s a Big Dill” Pickleball Tournament at the West River Community Center. Youth and Senior divisions will play on Friday evening; Men and Women will play on Saturday followed by Mixed divisions on Sunday. Saturday night there will be a social for participants to attend. Check in will begin at 7:30 am both days with tournament play at 8:00 am. Shirts are included if you register by the registration deadline.

Ages: 8\+

Fee: $35/player | $10/additional event

Deadline: April 14

Divisions:

2.5 \(men’s, women’s & mixed\),

3.0 \(men’s, women’s & mixed\), &

3.5 \(men’s women’s & mixed\),

4.0 \(men’s women’s & mixed\),

seniors doubles \(60\+ and any pairing of partners\) &

kid’s doubles \(8-14 years old and any pairing of partners\)

Schedule:

Senior and kids divisions will play on Friday evening \(starting at 4:30 pm, with check-in starting at 3:30 pm\).

Men & Women divisions will play on Saturday, followed by Mixed divisions on Sunday.

Saturday night, there will be a social for participants to attend.

Check-in will begin at 7:00 am on Saturday with play beginning at 8:00 am. Sunday check in will be at 8:00 am with play starting at 9:00 am.

Questions? Contact 701-456-2074 for more details.

events.title: 11th European Heart Congress
events.description:
The 11th European Heart Congress, taking place on August 09–10, 2027, in London, UK, is a premier international platform dedicated to advancing heart health, cardiac research, innovative therapies, advanced diagnostics, interventional procedures, and patient-centered cardiac care. The congress will bring together cardiologists, heart specialists, interventional specialists, cardiac surgeons, electrophysiologists, heart researchers, physicians, healthcare professionals, academicians, pharmaceutical and biotechnology experts, medical device specialists, and healthcare technology innovators to exchange knowledge, research, clinical experiences, and emerging developments in heart medicine and cardiac care.

Under the theme “Heart Health in a New Era: Innovation, Precision Medicine & Advanced Cardiac Care,” the congress will explore the rapidly evolving landscape of heart health and cardiac medicine, focusing on precision medicine, advanced heart diagnostics, innovative treatments, minimally invasive procedures, digital heart health, artificial intelligence, heart disease prevention, and personalized approaches to cardiac care. The scientific program will address major areas including coronary artery disease, heart attacks, acute coronary syndromes, heart failure, hypertension, cardiomyopathies, heart valve disease, arrhythmias, electrophysiology, structural heart disease, cardiac imaging, preventive heart care, congenital heart disease, and emerging cardiac therapies.

events.title: 3rd European Congress on Infectious Diseases & Immunology
events.description: The 3rd European Congress on Infectious Diseases & Immunology, taking place on August 11–12, 2027, in London, UK, is a premier international platform dedicated to advancing infectious disease research, clinical infectious medicine, immunology, microbiology, diagnostics, therapeutics, prevention, and global health. The congress will bring together infectious disease specialists, immunologists, microbiologists, virologists, epidemiologists, clinicians, researchers, healthcare professionals, academicians, pharmaceutical and biotechnology experts, vaccine developers, public health professionals, and medical technology innovators to exchange knowledge, present research, discuss emerging challenges, and explore advances in infection and immune science.
